# SkinCraft

> SkinCraft is a free 3D Minecraft skin editor for Windows 10 and 11. Users paint skins directly on a 3D player model and export a 64x64 PNG for Minecraft Java Edition or Bedrock Edition. It ships as a single standalone .exe with nothing to install.

Key facts:
- Platform: Windows 10 / 11 desktop (64-bit). Single standalone .exe, about 49 MB.
- Price: free, no ads, no account.
- Made by Steth22. Built with C# (.NET 9, WinForms + WebView2) and three.js.
- Similar idea to mobile "3D skin editor" apps, but for PC with mouse and keyboard.

Features:
- Paint directly on the 3D model or on a flat 64x64 texture view
- Mirror mode (paint left and right sides together)
- Tools: pencil (1-3 px brush), eraser, fill (area / face / body part / whole layer), color picker, noise brush, shade/lighten
- Base layer, overlay (outer) layer, or both at once; hide individual body parts
- Classic (4px arms, Steve) and Slim (3px arms, Alex) models
- Pose previews: still, idle, walk, wave, zombie, dance
- Skin library with autosave, rename, duplicate, delete to Recycle Bin
- Import PNG skins (64x32 legacy skins are converted), drag and drop, and copy any Minecraft Java player's skin by username
- Shortcuts work with any keyboard layout; performance mode for slower PCs
